text:
by Paul Craig Roberts, Paul Craig Roberts:
The Arktos Journal has taken up the case of Shiloh Hendrix on which I reported ( https://paulcraigroberts.org/they-are-not-rape-gangs-but-something-much-worse/ ).
Kevin DeAnna reports that the corrupt and anti-white Minnesota judicial system created a blasphemy law that is not on the books, a law that can only be used against white people, for committing lese-majeste against a black person by showing insufficient deference. https://www.arktosjournal.com/p/shiloh-hendrix-and-the-lie-of-law?utm_source=post-email-title&publication_id=1990457&post_id=208657080&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=dx5km&triedRedirect=true&utm_medium=email
The despicable Minneapolis Democrats set out to crucify a young white mother and actually took a misdemeanor charge to a jury trial with an anti-white jury. The judge, a Democrat white female appointee named Christa M. Daily, joined in the prosecution. Brian Karalus, Hendrix’s attorney said that his defense of his client was against the judge more than the prosecutor.
TRUTH LIVES on at https://sgtreport.tv/
The person who produced the trouble for Shiloh Hendrix is a black immigrant-invader, Sharmake Omar, who was not prosecuted by Minnesota “in the interest of justice” for raping a 16-year old American girl ( https://www.kaaltv.com/news/rochester-sexual-assault-case-dismissed/?utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email ). He used the stupidity of Americans to raise GoFundMe money and quickly left the country. DeAnna reports that the Democrat judge tried to prevent records of the trial from being made in order to make an appeal of the corrupt trial impossible.
Note that the white Democrat Minnesota judge sees her purpose as not serving justice but as punishing a white mother for not being deferential to a black who was harassing her.
Note that Joseph K. Rosholt, the Democrat Managing Attorney, Criminal Division in the Minnesota county of Olmstead, refused “in the interest of justice” to prosecute a child rapist.
This is the Democrat Party today. It is a party that represents immigrant-invaders and is out to get white American citizens and has succeeded in doing so. It was Minnesota that framed police officer Derek Chauvin and three other Minneapolis police officers in a “trial” that had every possible violation of the rules, any one of which was grounds for throwing the trial out of court. George Floyd killed himself by overdosing on fentanyl as the coroner’s report shows. All police video evidence shows Officer Chauvin’s knee was on Floyd’s shoulder, not his neck. Evidence did not matter. The anti-white Democrats, who had allowed Antifa and Black Lives Matter to loot and burn many white business areas in a number of Democrat cities, wanted a white police officer as a sacrifice to “oppressed blacks.”
Kevin DeAnna explains the terrifying precedent set by anti-white, anti-American, Minnesota Democrats in the Hendrix case:
“Every non-white in the country now has an active incentive to follow white people around with a camera, daring them to say something that might cause offense. Blacks can either get white people put on trial for saying something or perhaps attack them with impunity. Such standards only go one way. Even now, blacks are berating random white people in Madison, Wisconsin, following a police shooting and openly threatening violence. They are not being accused of disorderly conduct, and they never will be.”
White liberals have been working for many decades to subordinate white Americans to “people of color.” By the 1960s white liberals had white Americans so indoctrinated into believing they are racist that white Americans have accepted for 60 years discrimination in university admission, employment, and promotion in the name of “civil rights.” This policy has required the dismantling of a merit-based society, now regarded as white racism.
The institutionalized discrimination against white people in America has not harmed the Democrat Party. The Democrats and Republicans share the electorate more or less 50% to 50%. A majority win is small–51%, 52%. A landslide is 53%. A government that represents only a shade over half of the electorate is hardly a majority government. In Europe where a majority government is composed of coalitions of parties with no single party having more than 20 or 30% of the electorate means, as we see proof of every day, weak and ineffectual governments.
One might think that the anti-American, anti-white, anti-Christian, anti-Constitutional Democrats would be finished, but the Republicans are the party serving Israel.
